main_text.p: טוּשׁ Ch. Incrustare, Obducere parietem cæmento, Illinire, inungere. Ithpeh. אִתְטּשׁ Incrustari, induci, obduci. Ithpahel אִטְטּשׁ Turbari, foedari, maculari, turbidum, lutosum esse vel fieri. Syr. ܛܘܫ Ne pollyuerentur, contaminarentur, Johan.18.28.
טוֹת Ch. Jejunus, incoenatus, וּבָת טוּת Et pernoctavit incoenatus, Dan.6.19.
טְחוֹל Ch. Splen. Plur. cum Aff. טְחוֹלֵיהוֹן Splenes ipsorum, Esth.8.10.
טְחַן Ch. Molere, commolere, conterere, Hebr. טְחַן. Syr. ܛܚܢ Et duae erunt molentes, Matth.24.40.
טְחוֹר טְחוֹרִין, טְחוֹרִיָא Ch. Marisca, Haemorrhoides, ut Hebr. טְחוֹרִים, 1.Sam.6.17.&c.
טִטְלוּתָא Ch. Racemi, Levit.19.10. in T. Hierofol. Deuter.24.21. in Jon.
טוּטְפָא, טוּטְפְתָא Chald. Armilla: Tiara. Plural. טוּטְפָתָא, טוּטְפָן.
טִטָּר Syr. Tetrarcha. Graecū est τετράρχης.

טִים טִימִי, טִימִי Chald. ex formâ plurali, ܛܝܡܐ Syr. Graec. τιμή, Honor, reverentia: Pretium, aestimatio, utilitas, lucrum. Plural. טִימִין Genef. 23.15. in Targ. Jon. Est quoq; nomen proprium viri, Timaeus, Mar. 10.46.

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Greek entries are only approximated in places; Syriac and Hebrew vowel points are simplified. Some Hebrew forms in the Ithpeh/Ithpahel and Syriac lines are doubtful and should be checked against the scan.
